name: OR-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by six points on the 2024 baseline
Salinas is an incumbent with a large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price a Democratic win near 96%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Salinas: a Democratic-leaning district, incumbency, and a dominant money advantage against a challenger who has raised almost nothing. Markets agree, so the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin with only a modest discount for the absence of polling.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or polling showing the race closer than fundamentals suggest would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Andrea Salinas seeks a second term in a district that voted Democratic by about six points at the presidential level. She has raised over $1.6 million and holds more than $600,000 on hand, while Republican David Russ has reported under $13,000 raised and under $2,000 in the bank, with no outside spending on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put the Democratic win probability around 96%. With a favorable environment for her party in Oregon and a heavily outspent opponent, Salinas is a clear favorite, though the lack of polling leaves some room for surprise.
